environment.description: Flask application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). Instance runs Amazon Linux 2023 with Python 3.11. Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or proxy between NLB and application. SQLite database contains user records including PII (SSN stored in a 'notes' column accessible via UNION injection). Application started via systemd unit with User=appuser.

config.database: SQLite 3.40 with users table containing additional sensitive columns
